messages:
Linh (Design): quick design QA on the batch vectors preview + "Relevance" column. updated frames: https://figma.com/file/unique-id
Marco (Frontend): looking. what are the show-stoppers?
Linh (Design): short list: 1) multi-page selection UX confusing — header shows "select all on page" only. 2) export modal keyboard flow: ESC closes but focus not restored to toolbar. 3) relevance badge color low contrast.
Yuna (PM): for product: default download should be .jsonl; CSV must prompt column mapping and show a live preview. also header CTA should surface count when selection spans pages.
Rob (A11y): suggestions: persist selection in a SR-friendly way and update an aria-live region with total selection count. ensure the toolbar button has aria-haspopup and aria-expanded when menu open. modal must trap focus and have accessible dismiss.
Sofia (Backend): we already accept batch export with ids array. large exports (>10k ids) will be background jobs. API: POST /exports {format, ids, mapping}. we'll return job_id.
Marco (Frontend): plan: 1) persist selection in localStorage and reconcile with server; 2) aria-live announcement "n items selected"; 3) focus management: return focus to the download button. also add keyboard tooltip for truncated metadata cells and a copy icon with aria-label="Copy full metadata".
Linh (Design): microcopy: change primary CTA to "Download selected vectors (.jsonl)" and secondary to "Export CSV — map columns". in the CSV flow show a small inline example sample row.
Rob (A11y): add aria-sort on headers, and announce when sort changes. ensure relevance badge has at least 4.5:1 contrast or use a bold outline.
Yuna (PM): decision: persist last CSV mapping per-user and surface "Use last mapping" in modal. if mapping exists but no selection, the modal should disable "Export" until rows are selected.
Sofia (Backend): we'll implement background export + email webhook. also add approximate size in the response so frontend can warn about large downloads.
DeployBot: staging deploy finished with design tweaks. :rocket:
Linh (Design): next steps: Marco implement selection + focus fixes; Rob write small a11y checklist; Sofia add background endpoint; Yuna to finalize copy. aim: PRs by Monday EOD.
